abstract: The misdiagnosis of retroperitoneal teratoma as a gastric stromal tumor is rarely reported. There are numerous abdominal organs, and retroperitoneal tumors are easily concealed by organs situated more anteriorly on the abdomen; therefore, retroperitoneal tumors are easily misdiagnosed as human digestive system tumors by abdominal surgeons. We herein present the case of a 39-year-old female patient who was diagnosed with a gastric stromal tumor (GST) on preoperative examination, whereas the postoperative diagnosis was retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma. Such cases are clinically rare. In the present case, the tumor was located in the retroperitoneum, near the lesser gastric curvature, without an obvious gap. The anterior surface of the tumor was concealed by the lesser gastric curvature and did not move significantly with breathing and changes in posture. In such cases, a preoperative misdiagnosis is very likely. The aim of the present study was to improve our understanding of the presentation of retroperitoneal teratomas, thereby gaining more clinical experience and hopefully reducing the rate of misdiagnosis.
abstract_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫が胃間質腫瘍と誤診された報告はまれである。腹部には多数の臓器があり、後腹膜腫瘍は腹部の前方に位置する臓器によって容易に隠されるため、腹部外科医によって消化器系腫瘍と誤診されやすい。我々は、術前検査で胃間質腫瘍(GST)と診断されたが、術後診断で後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった39歳女性の症例を報告する。このような症例は臨床的にまれである。本症例では、腫瘍は胃小弯近傍の後腹膜に位置し、明らかな境界はなかった。腫瘍の前面は胃小弯に隠れており、呼吸や体位変換によっても有意な移動はなかった。このような症例では術前の誤診が非常に起こりやすい。本研究の目的は、後腹膜奇形腫の提示様式の理解を深め、より多くの臨床経験を得て、誤診率の低下に資することである。
